limitations.note: The agent fixed the unregistered write-domain Gray pointer, but also made both Gray pointers capture the next address rather than the current address, changing the cycle timing of `wfull` and `rempty` relative to the reference.

limitations.quote: empty did not assert on final read at depth %0d
limitations.note: The test required `rempty` to assert on the final read, enshrining the rewrite's timing instead of checking the extra read-clock cycle preserved by the reference.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: A disallowed cleanup trap caused the entire simulation command to be rejected before compilation, so the agent had to issue the setup and run again.
